## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (ruff + bandit + tests)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)

## Security checklist

- [ ] No new third-party runtime dependency in `src/`
- [ ] New inputs are size-bounded and validated
- [ ] No new sensitive data is written to reports or logs (or it is redacted)
- [ ] Any new network call uses a constant, non-input-derived URL
- [ ] Any suppressed lint/SAST finding is narrowly scoped and justified in a comment
